name: Advanced Vocab 04 - Leadership, Influence & Career Growth

cards.definition: The ability to guide and inspire others toward a goal (नेतृत्व क्षमता)
cards.exampleSentence: Strong leadership kept the team calm during the outage.

cards.definition: Guidance given by an experienced person to a less experienced one (मार्गदर्शन)
cards.exampleSentence: Her mentorship helped me grow into a senior role.

cards.definition: To guide and advise a less experienced person (मार्गदर्शन करना)
cards.exampleSentence: I mentor two junior engineers on design basics.

cards.definition: To help someone improve through guidance and feedback (कौशल सुधारने में मदद करना)
cards.exampleSentence: He coaches new joiners on writing clear pull requests.

cards.definition: To assign responsibility or tasks to others (काम दूसरों को सौंपना)
cards.exampleSentence: Learn to delegate instead of doing everything yourself.

cards.definition: To give people authority and confidence to act (सशक्त बनाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Good managers empower engineers to make decisions.

cards.definition: To develop and nurture a quality or relationship (विकसित और पोषित करना)
cards.exampleSentence: She cultivated strong relationships with the business teams.

cards.definition: To encourage the development of something (बढ़ावा देना)
cards.exampleSentence: We want to foster a culture of open feedback.

cards.definition: To care for and help something grow (पालना-पोसना)
cards.exampleSentence: Nurture talent and the team will outperform expectations.

cards.definition: To fill someone with the urge to do something (प्रेरित करना)
cards.exampleSentence: His clear vision inspired the whole team.

cards.definition: To give someone a reason to act (उत्साहित करना)
cards.exampleSentence: Recognition motivates people more than rules do.

cards.definition: To affect someone's decisions or behaviour (प्रभावित करना)
cards.exampleSentence: You can influence decisions without formal authority.

cards.definition: To persuade or change someone's opinion (राय बदलना)
cards.exampleSentence: The prototype swayed the sceptics.

cards.definition: To reach agreement through discussion (बातचीत से सहमति बनाना)
cards.exampleSentence: She negotiated a longer deadline for the first phase.

cards.definition: To help resolve a dispute between parties (विवाद सुलझाने में मध्यस्थता करना)
cards.exampleSentence: He mediated between the two teams on API ownership.

cards.definition: To reduce the intensity of a conflict (तनाव कम करना)
cards.exampleSentence: A calm tone helped de-escalate the situation.

cards.definition: To manage a complex or difficult situation (जटिल स्थिति से निपटना)
cards.exampleSentence: She navigated competing priorities with great skill.

cards.definition: To lead an initiative or effort (किसी पहल का नेतृत्व करना)
cards.exampleSentence: He spearheaded the move to automated testing.

cards.definition: To supervise and ensure work is done properly (देखरेख करना)
cards.exampleSentence: He oversees the migration across four teams.

cards.definition: A person responsible for caring for something (देखभाल का ज़िम्मेदार व्यक्ति)
cards.exampleSentence: He acts as steward of the shared platform.

cards.definition: Having original ideas about the future (दूरदर्शी)
cards.exampleSentence: The architect has a visionary approach to data platforms.

cards.definition: Relating to long-term planning (रणनीतिक)
cards.exampleSentence: This is a strategic investment, not a quick fix.

cards.definition: Relating to short-term actions toward a goal (युक्तिपरक)
cards.exampleSentence: The patch is a tactical fix while we plan the real solution.

cards.definition: Considering the whole rather than just the parts (समग्र)
cards.exampleSentence: We need a holistic view of reliability, cost and speed.

cards.definition: The overall view or general situation (बड़ी तस्वीर)
cards.exampleSentence: Keep the big picture in mind while solving details.

cards.definition: A strategic plan outlining future goals and timing (भविष्य की कार्ययोजना)
cards.exampleSentence: The roadmap prioritises resilience in the next two quarters.

cards.definition: A clear idea of what the future should look like (भविष्य की स्पष्ट कल्पना)
cards.exampleSentence: The team needs a shared vision for the platform.

cards.definition: A measurable outcome showing progress towards an objective (मापने योग्य परिणाम)
cards.exampleSentence: One key result is zero missed file deadlines.

cards.definition: A measurable value showing how well goals are met (प्रदर्शन मापक संकेतक)
cards.exampleSentence: File delivery time is our main KPI.

cards.definition: A quantifiable measure used to track performance (मापदंड)
cards.exampleSentence: Choose metrics that reflect customer impact.

cards.definition: The effect or influence of an action (प्रभाव)
cards.exampleSentence: Focus on work with measurable business impact.

cards.definition: The degree to which work is seen and recognised (कार्य की दृश्यता/पहचान)
cards.exampleSentence: Increase your visibility by sharing results in team forums.

cards.definition: The quality of being trusted and believed (विश्वसनीयता)
cards.exampleSentence: Consistent delivery builds credibility.

cards.definition: The general opinion about someone's character or ability (प्रतिष्ठा)
cards.exampleSentence: She has a reputation for calm, thorough debugging.

cards.definition: Honesty and strong moral principles (ईमानदारी और नैतिकता)
cards.exampleSentence: Integrity means admitting mistakes openly.

cards.definition: Deserving of confidence (भरोसेमंद)
cards.exampleSentence: A trustworthy engineer raises issues early.

cards.definition: Consistently reliable (भरोसेमंद)
cards.exampleSentence: She's the most dependable person on the team.

cards.definition: Being answerable for one's actions and decisions (जवाबदेही)
cards.exampleSentence: Accountability starts with owning the outcome.

cards.definition: The ability to act independently and take the first step (पहल)
cards.exampleSentence: She showed initiative by fixing the flaky tests unprompted.

cards.definition: A person who works without needing direction (स्वयं पहल करने वाला)
cards.exampleSentence: We want a self-starter who can pick up ambiguous problems.

cards.definition: An ambitious person who actively pursues goals (महत्वाकांक्षी और सक्रिय व्यक्ति)
cards.exampleSentence: He's a go-getter who volunteers for challenging tasks.

cards.definition: Able to find clever solutions with limited means (संसाधनपूर्ण / तरकीबी)
cards.exampleSentence: A resourceful engineer finds a way around blockers.

cards.definition: Able to adjust to new conditions (परिस्थिति के अनुसार ढलने वाला)
cards.exampleSentence: Adaptable teams recover quickly from changing priorities.

cards.definition: Able to do many different things well (बहुमुखी)
cards.exampleSentence: A versatile engineer moves easily between backend and cloud.

cards.definition: Able to move and respond quickly (फुर्तीला)
cards.exampleSentence: We stay agile by releasing small changes often.

cards.definition: Having a balanced set of skills (संतुलित क्षमताओं वाला)
cards.exampleSentence: Senior roles need well-rounded engineers, not just coders.

cards.definition: Having deep expertise in one area and broad knowledge in others (एक क्षेत्र में गहरा और बाकी में व्यापक ज्ञान)
cards.exampleSentence: Our best engineers are T-shaped.

cards.definition: A person with deep knowledge in a particular area (विषय विशेषज्ञ)
cards.exampleSentence: She's our subject matter expert on market data vendors.

cards.definition: An expert whose ideas influence others (विचार-नेता)
cards.exampleSentence: He became a thought leader on data resilience.

cards.definition: The person others turn to for help in a topic (जिनसे सब सलाह लेते हैं)
cards.exampleSentence: She's the go-to person for Kafka issues.

cards.definition: Someone or something that greatly increases others' effectiveness (दूसरों की क्षमता बढ़ाने वाला)
cards.exampleSentence: Good tooling is a force multiplier for the whole team.

cards.definition: A pioneer who creates a new path (नई राह बनाने वाला)
cards.exampleSentence: She's a trailblazer in adopting infrastructure as code.

cards.definition: Involving people from different specialities (विभिन्न विशेषज्ञताओं को जोड़ने वाला)
cards.exampleSentence: A cross-functional team ships features faster.

cards.definition: Working jointly with others on a task (सहयोग)
cards.exampleSentence: Collaboration between engineers and analysts improved data quality.

cards.definition: Combined effect greater than the sum of parts (सहयोग से बढ़ा हुआ प्रभाव)
cards.exampleSentence: There's real synergy between the platform and data teams.

cards.definition: A harmonious relationship of mutual understanding (आपसी तालमेल)
cards.exampleSentence: Building rapport with stakeholders makes negotiations easier.

cards.definition: Friendship and mutual trust within a group (मित्रवत साथ)
cards.exampleSentence: The team's camaraderie helped us through a tough quarter.

cards.definition: Welcoming and including all people (सबको साथ लेकर चलने वाला)
cards.exampleSentence: We aim to run inclusive meetings where everyone speaks.

cards.definition: A climate where people feel safe to speak up (बोलने में सुरक्षित महसूस करने का वातावरण)
cards.exampleSentence: Psychological safety lets people admit mistakes early.

cards.definition: Focused on learning rather than assigning fault (दोषारोपण से मुक्त)
cards.exampleSentence: We hold blameless postmortems after every incident.

cards.definition: Open and honest about information (पारदर्शी)
cards.exampleSentence: Be transparent about risks, even when the news is bad.

cards.definition: Honest and open expression (स्पष्टवादिता)
cards.exampleSentence: Her candour about delays built trust with the client.

cards.definition: A cycle where results inform future actions (प्रतिक्रिया चक्र)
cards.exampleSentence: A fast feedback loop helps us catch issues early.

cards.definition: Specific enough to act upon (कार्रवाई योग्य)
cards.exampleSentence: Give actionable feedback, not general criticism.

cards.definition: The belief that abilities develop through effort (विकास की सोच)
cards.exampleSentence: A growth mindset turns failures into lessons.

cards.definition: To learn new skills to stay relevant (नए कौशल सीखना)
cards.exampleSentence: I'm upskilling in cloud security this year.

cards.definition: To learn entirely new skills for a different role (नए क्षेत्र के कौशल सीखना)
cards.exampleSentence: Many analysts reskilled into data engineering.

cards.definition: A high degree of skill (दक्षता)
cards.exampleSentence: Proficiency in system design is expected at senior level.

cards.definition: Expert skill or knowledge in a field (विशेषज्ञता)
cards.exampleSentence: Her expertise in distributed systems is widely recognised.

cards.definition: The ability to do something successfully (सक्षमता)
cards.exampleSentence: Technical competence alone isn't enough for leadership.

cards.definition: A specific skill or ability required for a role (विशिष्ट कौशल)
cards.exampleSentence: Communication is a core competency for staff engineers.

cards.definition: The quality of a person's ability (योग्यता का स्तर)
cards.exampleSentence: The team hired engineers of exceptional calibre.

cards.definition: A history of past achievements (पिछली उपलब्धियों का रिकॉर्ड)
cards.exampleSentence: She has a strong track record of delivering on time.

cards.definition: A collection of work demonstrating skills (कार्यों का संग्रह)
cards.exampleSentence: His portfolio includes three large migrations.

cards.definition: Something successfully achieved (उपलब्धि)
cards.exampleSentence: List measurable accomplishments on your resume.

cards.definition: Reaching a significant point of progress (महत्वपूर्ण उपलब्धि)
cards.exampleSentence: The launch was a milestone achievement for the team.

cards.definition: Advancement to a higher position (पदोन्नति)
cards.exampleSentence: She earned the promotion through consistent impact.

cards.definition: A formal assessment of performance (मूल्यांकन)
cards.exampleSentence: My annual appraisal highlighted communication as a strength.

cards.definition: A periodic evaluation of an employee's work (कार्य-प्रदर्शन समीक्षा)
cards.exampleSentence: Prepare examples before your performance review.

cards.definition: An evaluation of one's own performance (स्वयं का मूल्यांकन)
cards.exampleSentence: Be specific and honest in your self-assessment.

cards.definition: A skill or aspect needing development (सुधार का क्षेत्र)
cards.exampleSentence: My growth area is presenting to senior leaders.

cards.definition: A challenging task beyond a person's current level (चुनौतीपूर्ण अतिरिक्त ज़िम्मेदारी)
cards.exampleSentence: The migration was a stretch assignment for me.

cards.definition: The path of someone's professional progress (करियर की दिशा)
cards.exampleSentence: Leading incidents has shaped my career trajectory.

cards.definition: The structured progression of job levels (पदोन्नति की सीढ़ी)
cards.exampleSentence: The company defines expectations at each rung of the career ladder.

cards.definition: A job change to a similar level in a different area (समान स्तर पर दूसरे क्षेत्र में बदलाव)
cards.exampleSentence: A lateral move into data engineering broadened my skills.

cards.definition: An employee who doesn't manage others (बिना टीम संभाले योगदान देने वाला कर्मचारी)
cards.exampleSentence: You can grow as an individual contributor without managing people.

cards.definition: A senior technical role focused on cross-team impact (वरिष्ठ तकनीकी भूमिका)
cards.exampleSentence: A staff engineer shapes technical direction across teams.

cards.definition: An engineer who guides a team's technical decisions (तकनीकी अगुआ)
cards.exampleSentence: The tech lead reviews all design proposals.

cards.definition: The extent of responsibility or work (दायरा)
cards.exampleSentence: Her scope expanded from one service to the whole platform.

cards.definition: The range of people and decisions one affects (प्रभाव का दायरा)
cards.exampleSentence: Senior engineers widen their span of influence.

cards.definition: The area in which someone has influence (प्रभाव क्षेत्र)
cards.exampleSentence: Focus on what's within your sphere of influence.

cards.definition: Handling expectations and communication with interested parties (हितधारकों के साथ संवाद प्रबंधन)
cards.exampleSentence: Stakeholder management is half of a lead's job.

cards.definition: Agreeing clearly on what will be delivered (अपेक्षाओं का स्पष्ट निर्धारण)
cards.exampleSentence: Early expectation setting prevents painful surprises.

cards.definition: To work effectively with and support one's manager (अपने प्रबंधक के साथ प्रभावी तालमेल बनाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Learning to manage up helps you get the support you need.

cards.definition: To publicly support something on behalf of others (पक्ष में आवाज़ उठाना)
cards.exampleSentence: He advocated for more time to pay down technical debt.

cards.definition: To express an opinion openly (खुलकर बोलना)
cards.exampleSentence: Please speak up if you see a risk in the plan.

cards.definition: To become involved to help or solve a problem (मदद के लिए आगे आना)
cards.exampleSentence: She stepped in to resolve the vendor dispute.

cards.definition: To admit a mistake honestly (ग़लती स्वीकार करना)
cards.exampleSentence: He owned up to the config error immediately.

cards.definition: To complete something that has been started or promised (वादा पूरा करना)
cards.exampleSentence: Reliable people follow through on commitments.

cards.definition: To continue something until it's finished (काम पूरा होने तक डटे रहना)
cards.exampleSentence: She saw the migration through to the end.

cards.definition: To take responsibility for your own commitments (अपनी जवाबदेही खुद तय करना)
cards.exampleSentence: Hold yourself accountable for deadlines you set.

cards.definition: To behave in a way that others will follow (उदाहरण पेश कर नेतृत्व करना)
cards.exampleSentence: Good leaders lead by example during incidents.

cards.definition: To act in accordance with what one says (कथनी और करनी एक रखना)
cards.exampleSentence: She walks the talk on code quality.

cards.definition: To set a higher standard (मानक ऊँचा करना)
cards.exampleSentence: The new review process raised the bar for quality.

cards.definition: To make additional effort beyond what is required (अतिरिक्त प्रयास करना)
cards.exampleSentence: He went the extra mile to document the system.

cards.definition: To act first without being told (आगे बढ़कर पहल करना)
cards.exampleSentence: She took the initiative to improve onboarding docs.

cards.word: step out of your comfort zone
cards.definition: To try something unfamiliar and challenging (सहज दायरे से बाहर निकलना)
cards.exampleSentence: Presenting to executives pushed me out of my comfort zone.

cards.definition: To start a new role or task with immediate effectiveness (पहले दिन से प्रभावी शुरुआत करना)
cards.exampleSentence: She hit the ground running and fixed bugs in week one.

cards.definition: To learn how a job or environment works (काम के तौर-तरीके सीखना)
cards.exampleSentence: It takes a few weeks to learn the ropes here.

cards.definition: To do your fair share of work (अपने हिस्से का काम करना)
cards.exampleSentence: Everyone on the team has to pull their weight.

cards.definition: To take on a large share of the work (ज़्यादा काम का बोझ उठाना)
cards.exampleSentence: He carried the load while the team was short-staffed.

cards.definition: To have many different roles or responsibilities (कई भूमिकाएँ निभाना)
cards.exampleSentence: In a small team, you wear many hats.

cards.definition: To manage several tasks simultaneously (एक साथ कई काम संभालना)
cards.exampleSentence: She juggles incident work and roadmap planning.

cards.definition: To handle more than one task at a time (एक साथ कई काम करना)
cards.exampleSentence: Constant multitasking reduces the quality of deep work.

cards.definition: Shifting attention between different tasks (एक काम से दूसरे पर ध्यान बदलना)
cards.exampleSentence: Context switching is the biggest productivity drain.

cards.definition: Focused work free from distraction (एकाग्र होकर किया गया काम)
cards.exampleSentence: Block mornings for deep work.

cards.definition: Healthy division of time between work and personal life (काम और निजी जीवन का संतुलन)
cards.exampleSentence: Good work-life balance reduces burnout.

cards.definition: Exhaustion caused by prolonged stress (अत्यधिक थकान / मानसिक थकावट)
cards.exampleSentence: Unrealistic deadlines lead to burnout.

cards.definition: The capacity to recover quickly from difficulties (विपरीत स्थितियों से उबरने की क्षमता)
cards.exampleSentence: Resilience helped her bounce back after the failed launch.

cards.definition: Persistence in spite of difficulty (दृढ़ता)
cards.exampleSentence: His perseverance solved a bug that others had abandoned.

cards.definition: Determination and persistence (दृढ़ संकल्प)
cards.exampleSentence: Her tenacity kept the migration moving through every setback.

cards.definition: Courage and resolve in the face of adversity (साहस और जुझारूपन)
cards.exampleSentence: It took real grit to finish the project alone.

cards.definition: A calm and controlled state of mind (धैर्य और संयम)
cards.exampleSentence: He maintained his composure during the escalation.

cards.definition: Calm confidence under pressure (संतुलित आत्मविश्वास)
cards.exampleSentence: She handled tough questions with poise.

cards.definition: Calm and sensible (शांत और समझदार)
cards.exampleSentence: A levelheaded response prevented panic.

cards.definition: Firmly committed and unwavering (अडिग)
cards.exampleSentence: She was steadfast in her commitment to quality.

cards.definition: Careful and thorough in doing one's work (कर्तव्यनिष्ठ)
cards.exampleSentence: A conscientious reviewer catches subtle bugs.

cards.definition: Devoted to a task or purpose (समर्पित)
cards.exampleSentence: A dedicated team worked through the weekend.

cards.definition: Pledged to a cause or activity (प्रतिबद्ध)
cards.exampleSentence: We're committed to delivering by the end of March.

cards.definition: Having strong enthusiasm for something (उत्साही / जुनूनी)
cards.exampleSentence: He's passionate about clean architecture.

cards.definition: Motivated by a strong desire to succeed (लक्ष्य के प्रति प्रेरित)
cards.exampleSentence: A driven engineer seeks out hard problems.

cards.definition: A challenging target requiring significant effort (महत्वाकांक्षी लक्ष्य)
cards.exampleSentence: They set an ambitious goal of zero downtime.

cards.definition: To flourish and grow successfully (फलना-फूलना)
cards.exampleSentence: She thrives in ambiguous, fast-moving projects.

cards.definition: To grow and develop successfully (पनपना)
cards.exampleSentence: Mentored engineers tend to flourish quickly.

cards.definition: To be exceptionally good at something (उत्कृष्ट प्रदर्शन करना)
cards.exampleSentence: He excels at explaining complex systems simply.

cards.definition: To do better than expected or others (अपेक्षा से बेहतर प्रदर्शन करना)
cards.exampleSentence: The new design outperformed the old one by far.

cards.definition: To do better than what was anticipated (अपेक्षाओं से आगे निकलना)
cards.exampleSentence: The team exceeded expectations by delivering early.

cards.definition: To perform well in a challenging situation (चुनौती पर खरा उतरना)
cards.exampleSentence: She rose to the occasion during the outage.

cards.definition: To have a positive effect (फ़र्क़ पैदा करना)
cards.exampleSentence: Clear documentation makes a real difference to new joiners.

cards.definition: To have a strong effect on something (गहरा प्रभाव डालना)
cards.exampleSentence: You can make an impact by solving customer pain points.

cards.definition: To contribute something useful or beneficial (मूल्य जोड़ना)
cards.exampleSentence: Think about how your work adds value to the business.

cards.definition: The benefit a product or service promises to deliver (मूल्य प्रस्ताव)
cards.exampleSentence: Our value proposition is faster, cleaner data.

cards.definition: To present an idea persuasively (विचार प्रभावी ढंग से प्रस्तुत करना)
cards.exampleSentence: She pitched the automation project to the director.

cards.definition: A brief persuasive summary of an idea (संक्षिप्त प्रेरक परिचय)
cards.exampleSentence: Prepare a thirty-second elevator pitch for your project.

cards.definition: Using narrative to communicate ideas effectively (कहानी के माध्यम से बात रखना)
cards.exampleSentence: Good storytelling makes technical updates memorable.

cards.definition: A short overview for senior readers (वरिष्ठों के लिए संक्षिप्त सारांश)
cards.exampleSentence: Start the report with an executive summary.

cards.definition: To show or explain something to an audience (प्रस्तुत करना)
cards.exampleSentence: I'll present the findings at Thursday's review.

cards.definition: A commanding, confident manner that inspires trust (प्रभावशाली व आत्मविश्वासी व्यक्तित्व)
cards.exampleSentence: Executive presence helps you influence senior leaders.

cards.definition: Dignity and seriousness of manner (गंभीरता और प्रभाव)
cards.exampleSentence: She speaks with gravitas about reliability.

cards.definition: To acknowledge someone's contribution (श्रेय देना)
cards.exampleSentence: Always credit teammates for their ideas.

cards.definition: To claim recognition for work (श्रेय लेना)
cards.exampleSentence: Don't take credit for work the team did.

cards.definition: To give others recognition (दूसरों को भी श्रेय देना)
cards.exampleSentence: Great leaders share the spotlight.

cards.definition: A senior person who advocates for your career (वरिष्ठ संरक्षक जो आगे बढ़ाए)
cards.exampleSentence: A sponsor recommended her for the lead role.

cards.definition: A meeting with your manager's manager (प्रबंधक के प्रबंधक से बैठक)
cards.exampleSentence: A skip-level meeting gives a broader view of priorities.

cards.definition: A private meeting between two people (आमने-सामने की बैठक)
cards.exampleSentence: Use your one-on-one to discuss career goals.

cards.definition: A discussion about professional growth (करियर विकास पर चर्चा)
cards.exampleSentence: I asked for a career conversation with my manager.

cards.definition: A structured plan for building skills (कौशल विकास योजना)
cards.exampleSentence: We agreed on a six-month development plan.

cards.definition: The difference between current and required skills (कौशल का अंतर)
cards.exampleSentence: We identified a skill gap in cloud security.

cards.definition: Passing expertise from one person to another (ज्ञान का हस्तांतरण)
cards.exampleSentence: Knowledge transfer prevents single-person dependency.

cards.definition: The number of people whose absence would stall a project (कितने लोगों के जाने से काम रुक जाए)
cards.exampleSentence: Our bus factor on this service is one.

cards.definition: Preparing people to take over key roles (उत्तराधिकारी तैयार करना)
cards.exampleSentence: Succession planning reduces risk when leads leave.

cards.definition: A position created to replace a departing employee (जाने वाले कर्मचारी की जगह भरने वाली नियुक्ति)
cards.exampleSentence: We're hiring a backfill for the senior engineer.

cards.definition: Gradual loss of employees (कर्मचारियों का धीरे-धीरे छोड़ना)
cards.exampleSentence: High attrition hurt delivery.

cards.definition: The ability to keep employees (कर्मचारियों को रोके रखना)
cards.exampleSentence: Good culture improves retention.

cards.definition: The confidence and enthusiasm of a group (टीम का मनोबल)
cards.exampleSentence: Frequent outages lowered team morale.

cards.definition: The level of commitment and enthusiasm at work (कार्य में जुड़ाव)
cards.exampleSentence: Autonomy increases employee engagement.

cards.definition: Freedom to make one's own decisions (स्वायत्तता)
cards.exampleSentence: Autonomy motivates skilled engineers.

cards.definition: To control every detail of someone's work (हर छोटी बात पर नियंत्रण रखना)
cards.exampleSentence: Micromanaging kills creativity.

cards.definition: Directly involved in practical work (प्रत्यक्ष भागीदारी वाला)
cards.exampleSentence: She's a hands-on lead who still writes code.

cards.definition: Not directly involved; allowing independence (हस्तक्षेप न करने वाला)
cards.exampleSentence: He takes a hands-off approach with senior engineers.

cards.definition: Friendly and easy to talk to (सहज उपलब्ध और मिलनसार)
cards.exampleSentence: An approachable lead encourages questions.

cards.definition: Able to understand others' feelings (संवेदनशील / सहानुभूतिपूर्ण)
cards.exampleSentence: Empathetic managers handle conflict better.

cards.definition: Providing encouragement and help (सहयोगी)
cards.exampleSentence: Her supportive feedback built my confidence.

cards.definition: Able to make decisions quickly and effectively (निर्णायक)
cards.exampleSentence: A decisive lead prevents endless debate.

cards.definition: Unable to make decisions (अनिर्णायक)
cards.exampleSentence: Indecisive leadership delays delivery.

cards.definition: Having great influence on others (प्रभावशाली)
cards.exampleSentence: She is an influential voice in design reviews.

cards.definition: A person whose opinion is trusted (विश्वसनीय आवाज़)
cards.exampleSentence: He became a credible voice on data quality.

cards.definition: To develop confidence between people (भरोसा बनाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Delivering small promises builds trust.

cards.definition: To gain admiration through actions (सम्मान अर्जित करना)
cards.exampleSentence: You earn respect by listening first.

cards.definition: To define acceptable limits (सीमाएँ तय करना)
cards.exampleSentence: Set boundaries to protect your focus time.

cards.definition: To decline politely and professionally (विनम्रता से मना करना)
cards.exampleSentence: Learn to say no gracefully to low-priority requests.

cards.definition: To discuss a salary increase (वेतन वृद्धि पर बातचीत करना)
cards.exampleSentence: Prepare evidence before you negotiate a raise.

cards.definition: To justify a proposal with benefits and costs (व्यावसायिक औचित्य प्रस्तुत करना)
cards.exampleSentence: She made a business case for hiring two engineers.

cards.definition: To obtain money for a project (धन की व्यवस्था करना)
cards.exampleSentence: We secured funding for the platform upgrade.

cards.definition: To gain someone's support (समर्थन जीतना)
cards.exampleSentence: His demo won over the sceptical director.

cards.definition: To gather backing from others (समर्थन जुटाना)
cards.exampleSentence: She rallied support for the new standard.

cards.definition: To gain agreement and support from everyone (सबको साथ लेना)
cards.exampleSentence: We need to get everyone on board before launching.

cards.definition: To contribute skills or value (योगदान या कौशल लाना)
cards.exampleSentence: She brings deep domain expertise to the table.

cards.definition: To perform better than expected for your size or level (अपने स्तर से बेहतर प्रदर्शन करना)
cards.exampleSentence: The small team punches above its weight.

cards.definition: A reliable person who can be trusted with tasks (भरोसेमंद व्यक्ति)
cards.exampleSentence: He is a safe pair of hands for critical releases.

cards.definition: Someone who cooperates well with others (टीम भावना वाला व्यक्ति)
cards.exampleSentence: We value a team player over a lone hero.

cards.definition: Someone who learns fast (जल्दी सीखने वाला)
cards.exampleSentence: She's a quick study and mastered Kafka in weeks.

cards.definition: A person who picks up new skills quickly (तेज़ी से सीखने वाला)
cards.exampleSentence: As a fast learner, he adapted to the new stack.

cards.definition: A person who is rapidly becoming successful (उभरता सितारा)
cards.exampleSentence: She's a rising star in the platform team.

cards.definition: A person who contributes a lot without recognition (अनदेखा नायक)
cards.exampleSentence: The on-call engineers are the unsung heroes.

cards.definition: A highly experienced person (अनुभवी पेशेवर)
cards.exampleSentence: A seasoned professional stays calm in crises.

cards.definition: A team that works very smoothly (सुचारू रूप से चलने वाली टीम)
cards.exampleSentence: After a year, the team ran like a well-oiled machine.

cards.definition: A close and supportive group (आपस में जुड़ी टीम)
cards.exampleSentence: A tight-knit team communicates with little friction.

cards.definition: A group consistently achieving excellent results (उच्च प्रदर्शन करने वाली टीम)
cards.exampleSentence: High-performing teams value feedback.

cards.definition: A demanding request (कठिन माँग)
cards.exampleSentence: Delivering in two weeks is a steep ask.
